caveats: Root owns final Jev compile. Worker used direct catalog/typed solvers, not Jev.
Workflow traces are finite supplied facts (35/26 steps); guards and semantics were source-matched, not extracted or proved from Rust.
Typed query models one changed candidate, values 0..2 and absence -1, known identity/filter and complete feed coverage.
Shipped policy conservatively reloads changed candidates matching either old or new membership. It never treats an untracked/gapped mutation as unrelated.
No proof of physical races, full multi-row sorting/paging, unbounded liveness, trigger completeness, SQL equivalence or achieved latency. Runtime tests and separate benchmarks cover concrete cases.
Fixed validation/serialization optimizations retain both validation passes and the same lifecycle, budgets and fallback policy.
